Name: Wedding Mod
Author: Opalie
TagLine: This mod lets' you chose between 4 different places to marry instead of the town! (Available: Beach, Forest, Woods, Flower Dance area)
Description:
**THIS MOD IS NOW MP COMPATIBLE ! (but you can't marry a player yet. Sorry)**  

This mod lets you chose between 4 different places to marry instead of the town:  

- The Secret Wood  
- The Forest  
- Flower Dance area (requested)  
- The Beach  

The option will be given at the start of your wedding!  
You can customize yourself your wedding map by [editing the tbin](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Maps).   

**_Installation:_**  

Drag the folder in /Mods and you're done! To uninstall, just delete the mod.  

**_Credit:_**[Picked Fence](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/404)  
[Fountain](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2380)﻿  
Huge thanks to [Ran](http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/) for the [inspiration](http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/post/178212450246/wedding-bells) <3  

**_Languages:_**  

English  
Korean  
Spanish  
Portuguese  
French (soon)  
Japanese (soon)  
**_Bug Report:_**  

I will need your [log ](http://log.smapi.io/)and:  
- who did you marry  
- gender of farmer  
- option that got the bug  

**FAQ: My screen is black on my wedding day!**  
if you wedding is on the same day of a festival, it's sadly not working.  
**_To be added:_**  

- More Locations to marry (feel free to request some in the Post section!)  
- <s>Multiplayer compatibility</s>  
- Player/Player wedding compatibility  
**[GITHUB](https://github.com/Opalie/Wedding)**
